name: Data centre UPS (uninterruptible power supply)
description: Double-conversion UPS systems sized per data hall and paralleled to multi-MW capacity, bridging the IT load between a mains disturbance and generator pickup. The class follows the same specification pattern as industrial UPS but is driven by hyperscale density, lithium-ion adoption and, increasingly, grid-interactive operation.

subtypes.name: Double-conversion (online) UPS
subtypes.description: Full rectifier-inverter conditioning of the IT load; the standard for data halls.

subtypes.name: Modular / scalable UPS
subtypes.description: Power and battery modules added in-frame or in parallel as the hall fills.

subtypes.name: Grid-interactive UPS
subtypes.description: Fleets that sell frequency response or demand flexibility from the same batteries (see idc-grid-interaction).
